books.title: Let Us Pray
books.subtitle: Collected messages on the prayer life of the believer
books.author: Watchman Nee
books.description: A short collection of messages, translated and published in English for the first time in 1977, asking what prayer actually is: whether we are really praying when we pray, what gives prayer its power, and what the conditions of an effective prayer life are. Readable in an evening, and intended for repeated reading rather than a single pass.

books.title: The Spiritual Man
books.subtitle: On spirit, soul and body — and the believer’s walk after the Spirit
books.author: Watchman Nee
books.description: The longest and most systematic of the titles on this shelf: a combined edition of Nee’s treatment of spirit, soul and body, the flesh, the soul, the spirit, walking after the Spirit, and the analysis of the soul in its emotion, mind and will. Dense and structured — work through it in parts with a notebook rather than reading it straight through.

books.title: The Breaking of the Outer Man
books.subtitle: And the release of the spirit
books.author: Watchman Nee
books.description: Eight short chapters on the difference between the outward life and the inward one, arguing that an unbroken outer man frustrates the release of the spirit, and describing how breaking happens through discipline, dealings and the ordinary pressures of a life. A concise companion to The Spiritual Man.

books.title: How to Study the Bible
books.subtitle: Preparing the person, then the methods
books.author: Watchman Nee
books.description: Two sections: the person who studies, with its three prerequisites and the things related to the Holy Spirit, and then the methods — keys to studying the Bible and the practice of it. Useful as a method book even if you do not share its theological commitments, because the argument is that method is secondary to the condition of the reader.

books.title: Love Not the World
books.subtitle: The mind behind the world system, and the believer’s separation from it
books.author: Watchman Nee
books.description: A collection of sermons on the world as a system with its own mind and trend, and on what separation from it means in ordinary life. Short chapters, plain argument, and a recurring pastoral concern rather than a technical theology. The edition itself states that it is in the public domain.

books.title: They Shall Expel Demons
books.subtitle: What you need to know about demons — your invisible enemies
books.author: Derek Prince
books.description: Part teaching, part testimony: fundamentals of how Jesus ministered, the author’s own experience and failures, seven common questions, and then a practical section on recognising, preparing for and keeping deliverance. The most practical title on the shelf, and the one to read with a pastor rather than alone.

books.title: Lucifer Exposed
books.subtitle: The devil’s plan to destroy your life
books.author: Derek Prince
books.description: A study of the fall of Lucifer and of the strategies the author attributes to him — accusation, deception, temptation, condemnation — written to make the reader alert rather than afraid. Pairs naturally with They Shall Expel Demons, which takes the same subject into pastoral practice.

books.title: Victory in Jesus and The Lord’s Healing Touch
books.subtitle: Two books in one, on faith and divine healing
books.author: Kathryn Kuhlman
books.description: Two titles bound together, built largely from testimonies and sermon material from Kuhlman’s healing ministry. This is a scanned copy, so the text is an image of the printed page: read it on a large screen, and expect to zoom rather than search.
